name: temp-accuracy-mc
description: Issue #15's Monte Carlo local-mismatch sweep of design/temp_core.spice (idealised 500 nA IBIAS, same cell-level DUT sim/temp-core-designer-check/ uses): PNP pair/ratio, resistor-ratio and amplifier-offset mismatch contribution to #temp-accuracy-untrimmed and #temp-accuracy-trimmed, at the row's own binding points (temperature extremes x rail extremes). Process held at the deterministic 'tt' corner per binding point -- global process spread is #13's deterministic corner-sweep job; this experiment adds the local-mismatch axis on top, per spec/target-spec.md section 2's [3sigma] definition.
claim: spec/target-spec.md#temp-accuracy-untrimmed, #temp-accuracy-trimmed -- local-mismatch share, Monte Carlo, N>=500 per binding point, evaluated at the temperature/rail extremes the rows themselves name as binding. Complements the deterministic systematic/corner share published by sim/temp-accuracy-vt/ (#13).

terr_untrim_c.description: spec/target-spec.md#temp-accuracy-untrimmed ([3sigma], +/-3 C). Untrimmed error against the declared nominal K0=4.308842 mV/K, WITH local mismatch on (sw_stat_mismatch=1) -- this is the mismatch-inclusive counterpart to sim/temp-accuracy-vt/'s deterministic-corners-only terr_untrim_c check.

terr_trim_c.description: spec/target-spec.md#temp-accuracy-trimmed ([3sigma] stretch, +/-1.5 C). DERIVED per-sample (montecarlo.derive_temp_trim): each die's own 25 C reading stands in for a real one-point 25 C production trim on that same die -- see sim/temp-accuracy-mc/testbench/stimulus.spice and sim/harness/montecarlo.py's derive_temp_trim docstring for the full method, which mirrors sim/temp-accuracy-vt/analyze_derived.py's deterministic-grid derivation.
